title: Do the Brackets Match
statement:
A line is made only of the characters `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{` and `}`. It is balanced if every opening bracket is closed by a bracket of the same kind, and brackets are closed in the correct order: the most recently opened bracket must be closed first.

## Input
One line containing the bracket string `s`.

## Output
Print `YES` if the string is balanced, otherwise print `NO`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 100000`
